title: luaut project configuration
markdownDescription: Applies to every `.luaut` file in this folder and the folders below it, unless a nearer `luaut.config.json` takes over.

defaultSnippets.label: Roblox project
defaultSnippets.description: Roblox types, no aliases, no sourcemap

defaultSnippets.label: Roblox project with a Rojo sourcemap

types.markdownDescription:
Type libraries to load. Nothing is built in — not even `print` — so list what the project uses.

A name is looked up as the package `@luaut/<name>` (`"roblox"` loads `@luaut/roblox`); a library that is not installed is an error. A relative path (`"./types"`, `"./defs.d.luaut"`) loads the project's own definitions.

paths.markdownDescription:
Import path aliases, as in tsconfig. A pattern may contain one `*`, which stands for the same text in each target. Targets resolve from `baseUrl`.

```json
"paths": { "@shared/*": ["src/shared/*"] }
```

baseUrl.markdownDescription: Where `paths` targets resolve from. Default: this config's folder.

sourceMap.markdownDescription: A Rojo sourcemap (`rojo sourcemap -o sourcemap.json`). When set, `game`, `workspace` and each file's `script` are typed from the real instance tree. `null` for none.
